response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the medieval castle walls, but instead of the usual stone and mortar, the walls are now covered in a thick layer of neon-colored, holographic stickers. The once-majestic gates are now adorned with flashing LED lights and a giant, pulsing "WELCOME" sign.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a middle-aged man with a receding hairline and a thick beard, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the usual suits and armor, they're all dressed in futuristic, neon-colored jumpsuits.

ARIN
(to his advisors)
I've had enough of the traditional aesthetic. It's time to modernize our empire.

ADVISOR 1
But, Your Majesty, the people love the traditional look.

ARIN
(shaking his head)
The people are sheep. They need to be led to the promised land of... (dramatic pause)...VAPORWAVE.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The camera pans over the castle grounds, where workers are busy installing giant, inflatable palm trees and a massive, neon-lit "VAPORWAVE" sign.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

Arin's advisors look on in horror as the king reveals his latest decree: the construction of a giant, holographic "VAPORWAVE" dome in the center of the castle.

ADVISOR 2
But, Your Majesty, this is madness!

ARIN
(smiling)
Ah, but it's genius. The people will love it. And it will be the envy of all the neighboring kingdoms.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The camera pans up to the "VAPORWAVE" dome, which is now complete. It's a massive, glowing orb that pulses with a hypnotic, neon light.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

Arin sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who are all wearing VR headsets and looking like they're in a trance.

ARIN
(to his advisors)
Now, let's get this party started.

The advisors all nod in unison, and the camera zooms out to reveal a massive, holographic "VAPORWAVE" party, complete with dancing robots and a DJ spinning a sick beat.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
